title: import_linkedin: thinness guard on RFC-028 retirement sweep (closes #420)
description: import_linkedin's document_key-based supersession (application/profile_store.py persist_items) retires (hides) any existing ProfileItem whose lineage isn't restated by a new import, with no check that the new file is actually a superset/richer version. A thinner re-export (e.g. Basic vs Complete, or a partial Positions.csv) silently buries real history, indistinguishable from the user actually deleting that role. This is the same gap wingman#420 (Versioned imports should show a before/after, not just land) already names — build the before/after surfacing and the guard together, not as two separate patches. Default posture: report what would be retired and require explicit confirmation (or an explicit flag for a pre-vetted scripted run) before proceeding, per AGENTS.md's human-approval-before-external-action posture. Design: docs/LINKEDIN-WOVEN-SYNC-DESIGN.md (Phase 2). Covering issue: wingman#477.
acceptance_criteria: Re-importing a thinner version of a previously-ingested document (same document_key, fewer/different claims) does not silently flip existing ProfileItems to SUPERSEDED; the ingest report/CLI output names exactly which items would be retired and why, and retirement only proceeds after explicit confirmation or an explicit override flag. A re-import that is a genuine superset or update still supersedes/retires correctly as today. Tests cover: thinner re-import (blocked/reported, not silently retired), richer re-import (still supersedes as today), and the confirm/override path.

title: seed_from_connections: upsert instead of skip on name collision
description: Currently, a Connections.csv re-import skips any Person whose name already exists on the watchlist — company/position/connected_on/linkedin_url are never touched, so richer or changed data in a fresh export never lands. Reuse add_person's existing fill-blank-wins per-field merge pattern (application/people.py) instead of the current skipped_existing += 1; continue. Genuinely new rows still insert as new Person records unchanged; a person missing from a thinner re-export is never deleted. Design: docs/LINKEDIN-WOVEN-SYNC-DESIGN.md (Phase 1). Covering issue: wingman#477.
acceptance_criteria: A re-import of a person already on the watchlist updates any field where the new CSV row has a non-empty value, keeps the existing value where the new row is blank, and never deletes an existing Person absent from the new export. New tests cover: collision-with-richer-new-data (updates), collision-with-blanker-new-data (keeps existing), and genuinely-new-name (inserts).
